scope: Offline planning study. Nothing was edited in the worktree, nothing ran in Fusion and nothing is a scale weight.

basis.batteryException: Battery-side connector, lugs, fasteners, insulation and at most 12 inches per leg. Robot-side leads and permanently attached bumper mounts remain in R103.

rule.included: Robot structure and every mechanism in the inspected configuration; robot-side leads; permanently attached bumper mounts; battery tray and retention.
rule.excluded: Bumpers; battery with its battery-side connector, lugs, fasteners, insulation and at most 12 in per leg; the game piece.
rule.ruleArtifactGap: kickoff/rules-v0.json in the season project has no R103 entry. The basis above is the inspection-mass-552 ruleBasis (2025 V0, pp. 76/86/112). Confirm against the season's current manual revision.

exclusionCheck.note: The 52.800 kg heavy line set excludes the 6.17 kg battery, the 7.5 kg bumpers and the 0.816 kg piece. Possible small overlap: the electrical budget names 'main leads'; if those include the excluded battery-side 12 in per leg (est. under 0.1 kg) they are counted twice. Not credited.

accountingFindings.text: Two upper contingencies are stacked on an itemised pan: the 0.693 kg residual of the retired 8.2 kg allocation and the 0.5 kg high-case upper. The 0.693 kg was 8.2 kg minus named items and has no remaining basis once the bottom-up replaces the allocation (mass-plan already admits 0.165 kg overlap).
Joining is covered three times: 3.403 kg residual joining allowance, 1.5 kg hardware and finish, and the 1.25 kg high case, on a chassis whose 146 bodies and 116 screws are modeled.
The 0.25 kg loom high case stacks on the electrical remainder, which already names harness and branch extensions.

C2 and C3 credits vanish if inset_connected_mass.py is rerun: electricalAllowanceAfterSheetsKg = 7 - sheets and remainingFixedJoiningAllowanceKg = 8.087 - backers (which include the pedestals). Freeze both allowances as absolute values, or itemise them, before crediting either pocket.

README 'versusAllocation +1.074 kg' understates upper growth. The 0.908 kg chassis pan truss was also debited to the 8.2 kg allocation, so the upper is 9.274 + 0.908 = 10.182 kg against 8.2 kg (+1.982 kg).
commissioning.md still quotes the 552 figures (54.063 kg, 1.900 kg over R103); the r3 mass-plan heavy is 52.800 kg.

Battery tray and retention and permanent bumper mounts count toward R103 but appear in no line by name. They are assumed inside the joining or hardware allowances and must be named when those are itemised.

candidates.name: Retire the stacked contingencies and carry one item-specific growth layer
candidates.note: Removes 0.693 + 2.000 kg of second and third layers and adds 1.456 kg of item growth. Keep the 2 kg as an adverse field-mass sensitivity in the drive simulation if wanted; it is not an R103 line.

candidates.name: Pocket both equipment sheets about 30 % outside the key openings, device lands and screw rows
candidates.note: Sheets are in the deck-key load path: worst flat bearing 109.5 MPa of 120 at the (110, -95) key; deck-keyed ring cases 111-112 MPa. Pockets must keep a solid ligament around every key and the shear path between keys. Rerun the deck register and device-mount checks on the pocketed sheet.

candidates.name: Pocket the six keyed pedestals outside the key, nutbar and screw lands
candidates.note: The two rear pedestals are 0.372 kg each and about 83 % solid. Recheck the deck register, brace clamp paths and key backing.

candidates.name: Fixed inlet posts to 3/4 x 3/4 x 1/16 in tube with a designed post-to-spine attachment
candidates.note: Post lateral load 94 N, 24.2 N m at the foot (about 41 MPa in the tube). Contact faces stay; the conservative end allows 70 g for the attachment. Fixed part, so no moving-property change.

candidates.name: Grade 5 titanium for the 68 1/4-20 x 5/8 deck-retaining screws (91251A539)
candidates.note: Keys carry the deck shear; these screws retain. 5.94 g steel to about 3.35 g titanium each. Check preload and thread engagement in the tapped 6061 backing, and gall resistance.

candidates.name: Itemise the 5.496 kg electrical remainder from the selected articles and a routed harness
candidates.note: Not credited. 8 SPARK MAX + PDH are 1.423 kg sourced; the remaining 4.07 kg covers the ninth controller, roboRIO 2, radio, breaker, SB50 robot side, main and branch cables, CAN, sensors and mounts. A routed-harness bill is likely to release mass, but nothing in the project sources it yet.

candidates.name: Itemise the 3.403 kg joining allowance against the modeled 146-body chassis
candidates.note: Not credited. The chassis bodies and 116 screws are modeled; the residual must still name battery retention, permanent bumper mounts, truss-node gussets and rivets, nuts and washers. Until named it stays in full.

candidates.name: Drop the slip clutch by qualifying the 26 N m output route
candidates.note: Not credited. Needs a measured inhibit latency of about 1.5 ms or less; the owner decision makes the clutch mandatory until then.

candidates.name: Same-vendor wheel or tread change on the SDS MK4i
candidates.note: Not credited. The billet wheel with tread is 0.55 lb; tread choices differ by tens of grams and change the loaded radius, so the drive clock would need a replay. Falcon and Kraken variants are heavier.

candidates.name: Thin the pan crossmembers (2 x 1 x 1/8 in) or the sills to 1/16 in wall
candidates.note: Rejected. The crossmember roof bearing is already 68.6 MPa and would roughly double past the 120 MPa working limit; the sills carry the wheel saddles (124 MPa ring peaks) and sleeves.

candidates.name: Lighten the perimeter, socket rails, cassettes or wheel saddles
candidates.note: Excluded. The perimeter bumper cases are open at 149-241 MPa, the cassette rare-wall case is 122.6 MPa and the saddle ring peak is 124.0 MPa, all over the 120 MPa working limit.

candidates.name: Further moving-pan lightening (skins, webs, cradles, soft-stop bar)
candidates.note: Rejected. Off-post +0.07, leg B +0.14 and keeper +0.42 margins govern, and any moving change reopens the 12-case replay.

package.verdict: Meets 1.5 kg at the nominal savings (1.600 kg). At the conservative savings it gives 1.280 kg; adding the titanium reserve F1 gives 1.430 kg. On the stacked r3 ledger no non-harmful physical package reaches 1.5 kg (best 0.539 kg).
conditions: Freeze the joining and electrical allowances as absolute kilograms (AF4).
Pocket C2 and C3 in native Fusion on a new issue; reopen, census, STEP and re-measure.
Rerun the deck register, key backing and brace clamp checks on the pocketed sheets and pedestals.
Design and check the P3 post-to-spine attachment and the inlet portal end clips.
Weigh the clutch, encoder and other 11 estimated pan purchases at procurement.
